title: Interop day: committer authority on role changes (bans, adds) on both hubs
description: When Haven keeps the ratchet tree and checks who made a role change (Jason 238470: today only the target role is checked). Extend mimid-chat /roles with variants that give the member role no canBan, and no canAddParticipant; then on Haven's hub (or our copy at the new commit): a ban by a member without canBan, an add by a member without canAddParticipant, and a change not in the actor's authorized_role_changes must be refused; the same Commits refused by mimid's hub (hub/policy.rs authorize_commit). Today's ban test: mimid-1wgh.46.19, tools/interop/chat /ban.
notes: 2026-11-16 prep: mimid-chat 682585b adds /roles no-ban and /roles no-add. Baseline on local mimid (main): ban without canBan refused notAllowed; with canBan accepted; invite without canAddParticipant refused already at keyMaterial (mimid answers noConsent: hub/key_material.rs:131, no policy code in protocol-07 §5.2), so the Commit-level add check is not reached through mimid-chat. For Haven: their hub may not check keyMaterial authority; then the Commit-level check is what to test. Script: /host or /create; /roles no-ban; /invite <b>; /ban <b> (expect refused); /roles no-add; /invite <c> (expect refused); /roles ban; /ban <b> (expect accepted).
